name: Knuckle Paradise ®
description:
About This Game

Oh no! Jane has been abducted and forced into an underground fighting tournament! Punch your way with stylish combos and your sidekick... battle-chicken?! Explore an abandoned amusement park filled with drama and absurd situations in this non-stop single player beat’em up inspired by classic nineties action comedies.

Spectacular action, non-stop drama, and... a chicken?!

From the developers of ScourgeBringer and NeuroVoider comes Knuckle Paradise: a precise and juicy pixel art narrative fighting game! Inspired by classic buddy cop movies and character action games like Devil May Cry and Bayonetta, Knuckle Paradise combat is fast, it’s furious, it’s combo-based, and it’s so aerial you’ll send Jane - and Jane's enemies - flying!

Play as Jane, a retired boxer who finds herself stranded on an abandoned amusement park island. Has she been abducted?! It’s worse than that: she's been forced into an underground martial arts tournament taking place within the park!

It won’t take long for Jane to team up with Cocotte, a noble warrior chicken. Together, the duo will battle their way through the mysteries of the island, encountering and defeating powerful opponents along the way.

Use Cocotte’s special abilities to overpower your opponents in unexpected ways. Combos are satisfyingly punchy and immediately fun… while remaining accessible to casual players.

Break through the park and have a combo-packed adventure!

Find the hidden martial art magazines and unlock new skills for Cocotte while looking for protein bars to increase Jane's maximum health. Infiltrate a night club with your stealth skills, participate in car chases, get lost in the mirror house and more…

The park is full of combatants who are all cruising for a bruising, plus you’re sure to run into some real trophy-seeking challengers and their wacky moves. Meet a crew of endearing and quirky characters while beating your way through this story-rich, chicken-forward, deliciously dynamic character action adventure.
short_desc: A pixel-powered, combo-packed character action game starring Jane (a retired boxer) and her sidekick, Cocotte (a warrior… chicken?). Fight everybody. Learn combos from a pirate seagull. Fight harder. Level up your chicken. Find your kidnappers. Teach them a lesson.
